description: Source code for the TalkOverlayController class, managing the presentation, updating, and dismissal of a talk overlay UI component in a macOS application. It includes UI window management, state updates, and logging.

classes.name: TalkOverlayController
classes.description: A final class acting as a controller for managing the talk overlay UI, including presentation, dismissal, and state updates.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Presents the overlay window, initializing if necessary and setting its root view.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the overlay window with an animation and updates the visibility state.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Updates the current talk mode phase and logs this change.

methods.name: updatePaused
methods.description: Updates the paused state of the overlay and logs this change.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the overlay's level property, clamped between 0 and 1, if visible.

methods.name: currentWindowOrigin
methods.description: Returns the current origin point of the overlay window if available.

methods.name: setWindowOrigin
methods.description: Sets the origin of the overlay window to a specified point.
